title: Broken laptops: Edit opens the spare parts
items: On Stocktake and QR labels, a broken laptop's button is now 🔩 Parts: it opens its spare-parts check (each part usable / broken / used as spare, Total broken, note) instead of the asset form.
Need to change the asset itself? Press ✏️ Edit asset info in that window.

title: Stocktake: more info, ✏️ Edit in place, collapsed models, QR labels panel
items: Each asset line now also shows the ECC code, holder and department, purchase date with age, warranty end, remark, and the 🔩 parts condition of broken laptops.

✏️ Edit on every line opens the asset right on the Stocktake page (status, site, holder, department, serial, model, purchase date, remark…) — save and print without leaving the page. Same rules as Asset Inventory: parts check when a laptop is set to Broken; IT admins can 🔓 unlock a locked holder there.
Model groups start closed — open only the model you need (or Expand / collapse all).
🏷 QR labels (top bar) and 🏷 All QR labels (in a stocktake) open the full labels list as a panel on the same page — no new page. ✏️ Edit is there too, and on the QR labels page.

title: Stocktake: lists by model, tick & print labels, click to preview
items: In a stocktake, every list (Not scanned yet, Found, Found elsewhere, outside filter) is grouped by model with a checkbox per asset and per model.
Pick the paper (tall 6.5 × 14 cm is chosen for Broken stocktakes) and press 🖨 Print labels (N) — only the ticked labels print.
Click an asset to preview its QR label, change the paper there, and 🖨 Print this label.

title: QR labels: list, tick & print, preview
items: The labels page lists every asset straight away, grouped by model (biggest first), with filters for country, site, asset type, status and search.
Tick assets — or a whole model with its group box — and press 🖨 Print selected (N).
Click an asset to preview its label in the chosen paper size, with a 🖨 Print this label button.
Admins see 🏷 printed / 📷 scanned counts on each row.

title: Tall QR label 6.5 × 14 cm with spare parts
items: QR labels → Paper: "Tall label · 6.5 × 14 cm" — one label per page with a big QR, code, type / model, status, serial, PC No, place, department, holder and purchase date.
A broken laptop's label also shows its 🔩 spare parts: condition and each part (✓ usable, ✗ broken, ↪ used as spare, ? not checked) with the parts note.
A stocktake of Broken assets opens its labels in this size.

title: Reports page: one line per report
items: Reports are listed one per line — name and description on the left, Excel / PDF / HTML on the right — grouped as before; team-only reports are tagged (IT & HR, IT, admins).

title: KPIs: data quality by asset type · 7 new reports
items: KPIs → Data quality is now a table by asset type × country, with what is missing (no serial / asset code / PC No – AD Name / duplicate serial).

New reports (Excel / PDF / HTML): KPIs, Depreciation & book value, Stocktakes (QR audit), Handover & return (e-signed), Leavers checklist, Microsoft 365 licence reclaim, and QR labels & scans log (admins).
Reports page: new groups Overview and Lifecycle & audit.

title: KPIs: utilisation by asset type
items: Utilisation is now a table: one row per asset type, one column per country — each cell is Active ÷ assets of that type, with counts and an Active / Stock / Broken bar. Types are never added together.

title: Stocktake: filters, print & scan log, photos
items: New stocktake: choose Status (Active / Broken / Stock), Asset type and Department as well as country / site; assets scanned at the place but outside the filter are listed separately.
Printing QR labels asks what for (first label, replacement, a stocktake, other) and records who printed and when; admins see on each label how often it was printed and scanned.
Every QR scan is recorded (who, when, from a stocktake or the phone camera, result).
Admins are asked for a photo after each scan — saved on the asset (shrunk on the phone); photos show in the asset detail and the scanned-label page.

title: Unlock in place (IT admin)
items: Return / Hand over window: a locked asset shows the lock at the top with a 🔓 Unlock button for IT admins — signature and note are kept, then Sign & save.
Edit Asset: "🔓 Unlock now" in the lock message makes User Name / AD Name editable right away (no trip to History Usage).

title: KPIs, Leavers, Stocktake with QR, e-signed handover, M365 reclaim, depreciation
items: 📈 KPIs: utilisation, ghost assets, data quality, repair time, leaver recovery and depreciation — split by country, with a monthly trend.
🚪 Leavers: return checklist per person (assets, Intune devices, M365 licence, AD account); assets tick themselves when returned with an e-signature; % returned within 7 days.
📷 Stocktake: print QR labels, scan with the phone camera — found / found elsewhere (Move here) / missing / unknown; closing a stocktake gives the ghost-asset KPI.
✍ Handover & return with e-signature (asset detail, Leavers, scanned label): the signed PDF is kept on the asset instead of the paper form.
♻ Licenses → Microsoft 365 reclaim: upload the admin centre Active users report; leavers still licensed and users with no activity for 60+ days, per country.
Book value on every asset (straight-line, 5 years — Circular 45/2013 allows 3–8 for IT equipment).

title: Users & Audit: page access of every account
items: 🔑 Logins has a new column with the pages each account can open — ✎ can change data, 👁 read only — and its countries, next to last login, so access can be reviewed any time.
Worked out from the same rules the server enforces (role, team, countries, Asset Inventory access).

title: Reports: interactive HTML version
items: New 🌐 HTML button on every report: opens an interactive page in a new tab.
Dashboard: switch country (All / Vietnam / Thailand / …) or click a country chip, sort any table by clicking a column, show % of row, hover the mix bars for numbers, hide a colour from the bars.
Data tabs: search all columns (matches highlighted), filter by country, sort, 50 / 100 / 500 rows per page, download what you see as CSV.
Save the page (Ctrl + S) to keep it — it works offline.

title: Reports: numbers split by country, like the Dashboard
items: Report dashboards (Excel and PDF) now show each key number with the split per country (VN · TH · MY · …), like the Dashboard tiles.
Tables have one row per country — Office / Factory under Vietnam — with Total, Active, Broken, Stock (or the right columns for each report), a Total row and a status-mix bar.
By-type tables show one column per country, so countries are never just added together.

title: Reports: Excel dashboard with charts + PDF
items: Every Excel report now opens on a Dashboard sheet: key numbers, summary tables and charts (real Excel charts you can edit); the raw data follows on the next sheets, with filters and a frozen header.
New 📄 PDF button on every report: the same dashboard with charts, ready to print or email.
Asset / User Inventory sync still works with the new files: the Dashboard sheet is ignored on upload.

title: Audit Log: every login and every action
items: Users & Audit now records logins, failed logins, logouts, password changes, every change, Excel downloads and page visits — each with the user's IP address.
New "Logins" table: last login, last activity and failed logins (7 days) of every account.
Audit Log: search, filter by user / action / dates, hide page visits, page through all entries, download as Excel.

title: Reports: new Excel exports for the new functions
items: Devices (Intune / Entra): every device of AD users with compliance, last check-in / sign-in and linked asset, plus a sheet of differences to check.
User activity (AD / Intune / Entra): AD account, last AD logon, Intune check-in, Entra sign-in, days since last seen, and who needs a check (HR & IT).
Broken & Stock + spare parts: broken / stock devices with each laptop's parts check, spare parts per model and in total.
System Health (IT): collectors, latest status of every check, history of status changes.
Reports page is now grouped: Inventory · Devices & users · Maintenance · IT.

title: Broken laptops: parts check from Asset Inventory
items: Asset Inventory: a broken laptop's status is clickable and opens the parts check; below it you see "check parts", "N parts usable" or "total broken".
Setting a laptop to Broken (Edit, or Add Asset) now asks for the parts check first: all parts start as Usable — just mark the broken ones (or tick Total broken). Cancel = the asset is not saved.

title: Asset Inventory by user: "broken" is not a person
items: Assets whose AD Name or User Name is just "broken", "missing", "none", "stock"… are no longer grouped together as one user: each goes to its real user, or to "No user assigned".
Each user's header is now one line: name, email, position, then assets · devices · AD logon · manager · to check.

title: Spare parts: broken checkbox, all parts per laptop, remark, popup
items: Each laptop shows all 7 parts; tick "broken" on a part to take it off the count (untick to count it again).
The asset's remark is shown next to it; clicking the asset opens a details popup on the page.

title: Spare parts: counted from every broken laptop, by model
items: Each broken laptop counts as 1 of each part unless marked broken / used or Total broken.
Screen, Keyboard, Mainboard, Battery are counted per model (fit the same model only); RAM, SSD, Charger are counted together (fit any laptop).

title: Alerts box moved to Needs Attention
items: The 🔔 Alerts list is no longer on Maintenance & Repairs; it is at the bottom of the ⚠️ Needs Attention page.

title: Maintenance: SSD / Storage and Charger in the parts check
items: Broken laptops' parts check and the spare parts list now also cover SSD / Storage and Charger.

title: Maintenance: Broken & Stock devices + spare parts
items: All Broken and Stock devices are listed on Maintenance & Repairs, with a summary chart (status & type, laptop condition, country).
Broken laptops get a parts check: Total broken, or Screen / Mainboard / RAM / Keyboard / Battery as usable, broken or used as spare.
Spare parts list: usable parts by part and model, with the laptop they come from; Use marks a part as taken.

title: User Inventory: Needs check chart + last seen from AD, Intune and Entra
items: A chart at the top shows the people to check (no activity anywhere 90+ days, no AD logon 90+ days, not in the AD list, never logged on) and by country. Click a bar to list them.
The Last seen column shows days since the last AD logon, Intune check-in and Entra sign-in together. Resource accounts are left out.

title: Needs Attention: summary chart
items: Both Needs Attention panels now start with a chart of everything to fix — by what's missing, by country and by asset type. Click a bar to list those assets.

title: Devices: Needs check summary chart
items: A chart at the top shows everything that needs a check — by difference type and by country — for all devices, whatever the list filters.
The tiles also always count all devices; filters only change the list. Click a bar or tile to list those devices.
Asset Inventory by user: each user is now a separate block.

title: Bug fixes after a full review
items: Needs Info tile = Needs Attention list; tiles clear the Laptop filter; one person no longer split in View by user; sort works there.
Device Check links the right asset when Computer Nos repeat; merge respects locks; fewer false differences.
Country limits enforced on device actions, search and uploads; safer display of names (O'Brien etc. work).

title: Devices: compliance filter fixed
items: "Not compliant" / "Compliant" filters and tiles now use the same status as the Compliance column (Intune first, else Entra).

title: Asset Inventory: position next to each user
items: The user's Position and department (from User Inventory) are shown next to the name and email in View: by user.

title: Search shows Intune devices + SAP description mismatches
items: Asset Inventory search also lists matching Intune / Entra devices and who uses them.
Rows found only through the SAP asset description say so.
Device Check flags SAP descriptions naming another laptop's serial.

title: Merge puts the system first
items: Merging duplicates now takes PC No + Serial from Intune, User Name / AD Name from AD, and Brand / Model, Type, Location, Status from the record created from Intune.
SAP codes, department, cost center, purchase date and history stay from the old record.

title: Device Check: merge duplicate assets
items: Same serial on two assets (typos like O/0 included) and at most one with an SAP code → Merge: keeps the SAP record with the Intune Computer No + Serial, the other goes to the Recycle Bin.
Same serial on two SAP assets → flagged to check by hand, never merged.

title: Asset Inventory: view by user
items: Assets grouped by person, with each asset's Intune status and the person's other devices (PCs not in Asset Inventory highlighted, phones / tablets).
Switch back any time: View: list.

title: Device Check: Intune + Entra vs Asset Inventory (IT)
items: Devices → ⬆ Upload Intune + Entra: only devices of people in the AD list; nothing in Asset / User Inventory changes by itself.
Differences are highlighted (not in Asset Inventory, serial, PC No, user, brand) with Use Intune value / Mark as checked.
Compliance, company / personal, managed by, and days since the last check-in / sign-in.

title: AD upload: resource accounts are kept
items: Shared mailboxes / email groups (OU …/Resources) are now added to User Inventory too, marked Resource.
New filter: AD: resource accounts.

title: User Inventory: Last logon column
items: "Last updated" replaced by Last logon: date + days since (amber after 30 days, red after 90, "never" if the account never logged on).
New sort: longest since last logon first.
The AD account is shown in bold in the email (e.g. abilgili@hayat.com.tr), with the manager underneath.

title: User Inventory: upload the AD user list (IT admin)
items: ⬆ Upload AD list: preview first, then apply — matches people by AD account / email / name, adds new people, merges doubles, skips resource accounts (shared mailboxes, groups).
Each person shows their AD account, manager and last logon (red after 90 days).
New filters: Not in latest AD list · AD: no logon for 90+ days · AD: never logged on.

title: New: System Health page (IT)
items: Live status of routers, switches, servers and internal web apps, refreshed every 30 seconds.
First system: the DrayTek router — up time, WAN 1 / 2 / 4G backup up or down, live traffic.
IT gets an alert when something goes down or an office stops reporting.

title: Location & Operations and User Inventory tiles: evenly spread
items: The small figures under each tile are chips spread evenly across the tile (like Justify in Word): label on the left, number on the right.

title: Smaller summary tiles
items: Number and country split on one line — Dashboard, Asset Inventory and User Inventory tiles take about half the height.

title: "New app function update" box on the Dashboard
items: See what was deployed lately, newest first.

title: Asset & User Inventory: new summary tiles
items: Same style as the Dashboard: big number + split by country.
Click a tile or a country chip to filter the list (Needs Info opens Needs Attention for that country).

title: Custody Agreement prints on one A4 page
items: No more second page when printing.

title: User Inventory fits the screen
items: Email shows under the name, Devices column removed — all columns visible without scrolling sideways.

title: Lists show the latest changes first
items: Asset Inventory and User Inventory are sorted by last updated, with a Last updated column and New / Edited tags.

title: Devices page (Intune & Entra) — IT admin
items: Microsoft device list linked to assets and users.
Bulk import is paused for now; the first import was undone.

title: Users can manage one or more countries
items: Viewer / Editor / Admin can be global (all countries) or limited to the countries they manage.

title: Custody Agreement (HQ form)
items: New 🖨️ button in asset details prints the HQ custody form, incl. Asset No (S/4).

title: Needs Attention: fix missing info on the spot
items: Split by country, edit directly in the list — no need to open each asset.
Missing AD Name / PC No only checked for laptops and desktops.

title: Dashboard redesign
items: Totals split by country and status, Assets by Country / Type, Vietnam Office & Factory.
Top Models and Alerts side by side; Alerts is a pop-up button on the inventory pages.

title: Asset Inventory improvements
items: Years in Use column (from purchase date), Asset Type filter, Office / Factory filter.
Laptops, desktops and phones listed first; "Code" renamed to "Asset code".
